lines.translation: All the continents, islands and worlds meditate in remembrance.
The nether worlds and spheres meditate in remembrance on that True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: simarahi khaanee simarahi baanee simarahi sagale har janaa ||2||
lines.translation: The sources of creation and speech meditate in remembrance; all the Lord's humble servants meditate in remembrance. ||2||
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva meditate in remembrance.
The three hundred thirty million gods meditate in remembrance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਜਖੵਿ ਦੈਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਗਨਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜਸੁ ਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: simarahi jakhy dait sabh simarahi aganat na jaaee jas ganaa ||3||
lines.translation: The titans and demons all meditate in remembrance; Your Praises are uncountable - they cannot be counted. ||3||
All the beasts, birds and demons meditate in remembrance.
The forests, mountains and hermits meditate in remembrance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਤਾ ਬਲੀ ਸਾਖ ਸਭ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਮਨਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: lataa balee saakh sabh simarahi rav rahiaa suaamee sabh manaa ||4||
lines.translation: All the vines and branches meditate in remembrance; O my Lord and Master, You are permeating and pervading all minds. ||4||
All beings, both subtle and gross, meditate in remembrance.
The Siddhas and seekers meditate in remembrance on the Lord's Mantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gupat pragat simarahi prabh mere sagal bhavan kaa prabh dhanaa ||5||
lines.translation: Both the visible and the invisible meditate in remembrance on my God; God is the Master of all worlds. ||5||
Men and women, throughout the four stages of life, meditate in remembrance on You.
All social classes and souls of all races meditate in remembrance on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਭਿ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰੈਣੀ ਅਰੁ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: simarahi gunee chatur sabh bete simarahi rainee ar dinaa ||6||
lines.translation: All the virtuous, clever and wise people meditate in remembrance; night and day meditate in remembrance. ||6||
Hours, minutes and seconds meditate in remembrance.
Death and life, and thoughts of purification, meditate in remembrance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਉਣ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: simarahi saun saasatr sa(n)jogaa alakh na lakheeai ik khinaa ||7||
lines.translation: The Shaastras, with their lucky signs and joinings, meditate in remembrance; the invisible cannot be seen, even for an instant. ||7||
The Lord and Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa jis bhagatee laavahu janam padaarath so jinaa ||8||
lines.translation: That person, whom You bless with Your Grace, and link to Your devotional service, wins this invaluable human life. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai man voothaa prabh apanaa ||
lines.translation: He, within whose mind God dwells,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorai karam gur kaa jap japanaa ||
lines.translation: has perfect karma, and chants the Chant of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਰੁਨਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar so prabh jaataa bahuR na jonee bharam runaa ||9||
lines.translation: One who realizes God pervading deep within all, does not wander crying in reincarnation again. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad vasai man jaa kai ||
lines.translation: Pain, sorrow and doubt run away from that one,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh darad bhram taa kaa bhaagai ||
lines.translation: Within whose mind the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d naam ras anahad baanee sahaj dhunaa ||10||
lines.translation: Intuitive peace, poise and bliss come from the sublime essence of the Naam; the unstruck sound current of the Guru's Bani intuitively vibrates and resounds. ||10||
He alone is wealthy, who meditates on God.
He alone is honorable, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੋ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਨਾ ਛਿਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham jaa kai man voothaa so poor kara(n)maa naa chhinaa ||11||
lines.translation: That person, within whose mind the Supreme Lord God abides, has perfect karma, and becomes famous. ||11||
The Lord and Master is pervading the water, land and sky.
There is no other said to be so.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan a(n)jan kaatio bhram sagalaa avar na deesai ek binaa ||12||
lines.translation: The ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom has eradicated all doubts; except the One Lord, I do not see any other at all. ||12||
The Lord's Court is the highest of the high.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahan na jaaee a(n)t na paaraa ||
lines.translation: His limit and extent cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਿਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer athaah suaamee atul na jaaee kiaa minaa ||13||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master is profoundly deep, unfathomable and unweighable; how can He be measured? ||13||
You are the Creator; all is created by You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar na koee beeaa ||
lines.translation: Without You, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh toohai sagal pasaaraa tum tanaa ||14||
lines.translation: You alone, God, are in the beginning, the middle and the end. You are the root of the entire expanse. ||14||
The Messenger of Death does not even approach that person
who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath taa ke pooran jo sravanee prabh kaa jas sunaa ||15||
lines.translation: All desires are fulfilled, for one who listens with his ears to the Praises of God. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sabhanaa kaa sabh ko teraa ||
lines.translation: You belong to all, and all belong to You,
O my true, deep and profound Lord and Master.
